Home education isn’t there to look just like traditional school.  We home educate so that we have freedom and flexibility to chase waves in the van! 🚐🏄‍♂️🏄🏼‍♀️🌊 

We do math when the tide changes and the waves are in a lull. 

We read aloud a lot throughout the day! 

Who says history has to be taught from a textbook when we can immerse ourselves in a historical narrative novel, learn all the important facts, but still be begging mom to read the next chapter because the story is just that good! 

Why would science have to be so sterile with worksheets when we can experience it in nature a
{{product.brand}}

These look like simple games. They’re doing a lot more than that. 🧩

Focus, logic and memory are skills, exactly like reading and math. The difference is that nobody schedules practice for them.

We give kids thirty minutes a day of reading practice and zero minutes of attention practice, and then we’re surprised when they can’t hold on to a task. 🤷‍♀️

That’s the gap NeuroKids fills in our house.

Ten minutes, screen free, at the kitchen table. It gets my kids to slow down, work something out, and think it through on their own instead of asking me for the answer after eleven seconds.
